thread:
maya: During the quarterly access review I found 11 ownerless service accounts in payments-prod. 2 have cross-account KMS grants and 1 has an Owner binding. Need triage and plan.

rob: thanks. uploaded CSV: https://drive.internal/redwood/access-reviews/4177771234_payments_orphans.csv columns: svcacct,last_used,roles,kms_grants,iam_path

jules: mark any entry with external kms_grants as `requires-kms-handshake`. we can't blind-delete those.

rob: workflow proposal: create SecTracker tickets per svcacct -> assign to last committer on iam_path or owning team -> 72hr claim window -> if unclaimed, schedule KMS handshake + revoke.

jiang: for KMS-bound ones I'll provision a temp key and run a canary cohort (5% callers) during a maintenance window 03:00-04:00 UTC. rotate callers to temp key, monitor decrypts, then rotate callers and revoke original grants.

maya: add a temporary monitor for failed decrypts threshold 3 failures / 5m. page eng-oncall on breach.

oncall-bot: created monitor "kms-handshake-4177771234" -> paging: eng-oncall sev2 on threshold breach.

security-bot: policy note: disabling principals with persistent KMS grants requires two-person approval and SecEng lead sign-off. use `emergency-revoke` only after approvals.

jules: also capture evidence bundle for audit: last_used logs, PRs touching iam_path, dry-run output, and attestation field in the ticket (claimed_by + evidence_link + risk_level).

maya: timeline: start triage today, tickets created by EOD, owners claimed by EOD+3, revocations with KMS-handshake scheduled EOD+8 if unclaimed. I'll post SecTracker links here when created. :white_check_mark:
